title: stachys palustris subsp. ambigua
intro: Stachys palustris subsp. ambigua, commonly known as marsh woundwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of marsh woundwort include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of marsh woundwort include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
